description: Presidential Secretariat - Resignation of 23 State Ministers Including Hon. Arundika Fernando
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists named individuals (Hon. State Ministers) who have relinquished their offices. While their specific portfolios are listed, the content focuses solely on the personnel changes (resignations) without detailing or assigning new portfolio responsibilities. The notification is about who is leaving their positions, not what new functions or structures are being created, making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
